title: Pip Cleans Up the Barn
checkpoint: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Pip finds a mess in the old barn.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing at the entrance of an old wooden barn, looking at straw and seed scattered everywhere.

pages.text: Straw and seed are spread all over.
pages.illustration: Straw and loose seed scattered messily across the floor of the barn.

pages.text: Pip did not make this mess.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking around with a puzzled expression at the scattered mess.

pages.text: Pip picks up the straw bit by bit.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow picking up small bits of straw in his beak, one at a time.

pages.text: Pip sweeps the seed into a neat pile.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow using his wing to sweep loose seed into a tidy little pile.

pages.text: Pip sets the straw back in its spot.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow placing the gathered straw back into a neat stack in the corner of the barn.

pages.text: The barn looks neat and tidy.
pages.illustration: A wide view of the barn, now clean and tidy, straw stacked and seed swept away.

pages.text: Moss sees the clean barn and grins.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog arriving at the barn entrance, looking surprised at how clean it is.

pages.text: Moss asks Pip about the mess.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog talking to Pip the sparrow, both standing in the tidy barn.

pages.text: Pip grins. The barn is tidy once more.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing proudly in the middle of the tidy barn, grinning.
